To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that

the factors of performance expectancy, social influence, and facilitating conditions, and trust of internet are the most important factors that influence citizens' intention to use e-gov services, and trust of government is the least important factor.

performance expectancy, social influence, and facilitating conditions have a positive effect in behavioral intention to use of e-government services and trust of Internet has a positive effect in performance expectancy.
performance expectancy, social influence, facilitating conditions, and trust of internet are significant determinants of behavioral intention of e-government service usage.
In summary, our research is concerned with
the factors affecting adoption of e-government services by Turkish citizens.
the adoption of electronic government services by citizens and the factors that affect this process.
the adoption of e-government services by citizens in Turkey and the factors that play role on the decision making process.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
the adoption of e-government services by Turkish citizens is positively affected by the factors of Performance expectancy, Social Influence, Facilitating Conditions, and Trust of the Internet.
this research has revealed that Turkish citizens have positive attitude toward using e-government services.
the results of the current study show the importance of the performance expectancy and social influence factors on behavioral intention to adopt e-government services.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
we have investigated underlying factors that play a role in citizens' intention to use e-Government services in Turkey.
the results of the study show that citizens of Turkey perceive e-government services as an easy and beneficial tool to interact with government.

, we found out the underlying factors that play a role on citizens' decision to adopt and use e-government services and also found out that trust of internet and trust of government are important in citizens' decision making process regarding e-government services.
The main takeaway from our work is that
trust is an important factor that should not be overlooked when developing e-government services.
trust of Internet and trust of government have a positive effect in the adoption of e-government services.
, although the Turkish government has taken many steps in providing e-government services, there are many aspects to be improved in the services and the way they are delivered to citizens.
